mandatoryCriteria: Authorized update: Workspace owner and granted Project Manager can update project name and description via PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId
Role restrictions: Project members and viewers receive 403 FORBIDDEN; outsiders receive 404 NOT_FOUND
Workspace ownership inviolability: Project Manager cannot alter workspace ownership, workspace name, or project workspace assignment
Optimistic Concurrency Control: Requires expectedVersion in update payload; rejects mismatched or stale versions with 409 STALE_VERSION
Input validation: Project name cannot be an empty string; unknown fields rejected; version increments on successful update
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId endpoint, name and description updates, OCC expectedVersion checks, and Project Manager authority limits on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Project archiving and reopening are handled under PRJ-04 / PRJ-06.
